default.title: Starter statements

statements.text: I can give a reason for my answer, not only the answer.
I can weigh evidence on more than one side before I decide, and explain my choice.
I can try another way when my first way does not work.
I can carry what I learnt in one place into a new situation, and adjust it to fit.
I can ask my own questions about what I am learning.
I can come up with an idea of my own, test it, and improve it.
I can explain an idea clearly in my own words.
I can change how I explain something to suit my listener, and check that they understood.
I can do my share of the work in a group.
I can help my group decide together, and make room for every voice.
I can find information and say where it came from.
I can check whether a source is reliable before I use it, and use it honestly.
I can connect what I learn to life in Singapore.
I can play my part to make my school or community better.
I can link what I learn to something happening in the wider world.
I can explain how an issue beyond Singapore affects people here, and what we could do.
I can notice that people from other backgrounds may see things differently.
I can work respectfully with people whose culture or beliefs differ from mine.
I can name what I feel and why.
I can say what I am good at and what I am not yet good at, with an example of each.
I can plan my time to finish what I start.
I can keep going and manage my feelings when things get hard.
I can notice how others are feeling.
I can see a situation from someone else’s point of view, even when I disagree.
I can ask for help when I need it.
I can work through a disagreement and keep the relationship.
I can think about who is affected before I make a choice.
I can make a fair choice and take responsibility for what follows.
